## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible change.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated work.
- [ ] `pnpm release:check` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior or public type changes.
- [ ] Documentation and migration notes match the public API.
- [ ] No generated output, package archive, credential, or private data is committed.
